name: io.github.shaumik/pokearena
title: PokéArena
description: Play a real 6v6 Pokémon battle. Runs entirely in-process: no server, no API key, no setup.

environmentVariables.name: POKEARENA_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional, and only used by the join_battle tool. Leave it unset to play offline against the built-in AI, which needs no server at all. Set it to a running PokeArena arena (ws:// or wss://) to face a human or another agent instead.
